scope: Source-level explanatory-diagram audit of every canonical lesson; selective visual inspection; not a full numerical or live-browser audit.

lessons.title: Set up your learning workspace
lessons.existingFigureTitle: From a saved file to a verified result
lessons.proposal: Separate working folder, saved file and selected Python environment; connect the interpreter to the observed device and checked output.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: The Windows path must not require shell activation; identify the exact interpreter that runs the file.

lessons.title: Meet your arrays and devices
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Rows are groups of observations
lessons.proposal: Keep the values heatmap; add row/column brackets and reduction arrows for axis 0 and axis 1.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Compute both sums independently and label input/output shapes.

lessons.title: Practice with four virtual CPU devices
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Four logical devices own four different rows
lessons.proposal: Keep categorical row ownership; enclose four logical CPU devices inside one host boundary.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Do not depict four machines or accelerator performance; match the device receipt.

lessons.title: Move your experiment to a TPU
lessons.existingFigureTitle: The same prediction checked two ways
lessons.proposal: Show host input, device placement, dispatch, completion and independent NumPy comparison.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Attach separate requested/observed platform labels; CPU equality does not verify TPU execution.

lessons.title: From NumPy to jax.numpy
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Center each feature around its own mean
lessons.proposal: Trace each feature column through its mean and broadcast subtraction; show fit-on-training/apply-to-held-out separately.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Centered training column means are zero within tolerance; held-out means need not be zero.

lessons.title: Shapes, broadcasting, and dtypes
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Broadcasting repeats the bias across rows
lessons.proposal: Upgrade existing shape cards into aligned axes for a nonsquare batch; include the accidental outer broadcast of (n,1) minus (n,).
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Show the erroneous (n,n) result and the intended (n,) result with actual values.

lessons.title: Pure functions and explicit inputs
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Explicit parameters make predictions inspectable
lessons.proposal: Show explicit parameters and inputs entering prediction; contrast with a hidden mutable global dependency.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Every changing value that determines the output has an input edge; avoid suggesting mutation is always observed by jit.

lessons.title: Immutable updates and indexing
lessons.existingFigureTitle: An update returns a new array
lessons.proposal: Branch one source array into set and add results beside the existing heatmap.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Original values remain unchanged; diagram value semantics without promising physical buffer allocation.

lessons.title: Your first gradient
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A tangent describes local change
lessons.proposal: Keep the tangent plot and interactive gradient view; strengthen the label connecting slope to a small input change.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: At the marked point, independently compare the derivative with a finite difference.

lessons.title: Losses and value_and_grad
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Loss and slope answer different questions
lessons.proposal: Separate loss and derivative into panels with a shared parameter axis and distinct units.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: A zero slope need not mean zero loss; mark both quantities at the same parameter value.

lessons.title: Batch a function with vmap
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Vectorization keeps one result per row
lessons.proposal: Map batch rows through one function with shared weights, then stack outputs; label in_axes and out_axes.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Match the recorded outputs 1, 1, 8 and shapes; vmap must not be drawn as a hardware-thread scheduler.

lessons.title: Compile a function with jit
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Compilation preserves the result
lessons.proposal: Show first call tracing/lowering/compilation/execution and a compatible warm call reusing compiled work.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Separate host dispatch from device completion; equal outputs alone establish no speedup.

lessons.title: Tracing, static arguments, and recompilation
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Static choices select a traced program
lessons.proposal: Replace the simple sequence with a signature/cache decision view for dynamic values, shapes, dtypes and static arguments.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Keep tracing and compilation distinct; bind examples to the actual function and process.

lessons.title: Random keys without surprises
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Reused keys replay the same sample
lessons.proposal: Upgrade the existing cards to a key split tree with one-use ownership and a highlighted reused-key branch.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Same key plus same sampler reproduces values; a few different samples do not prove statistical independence.

lessons.title: Pytrees and structured parameters
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A gradient tree matches parameter leaves
lessons.proposal: Align parameter, gradient and optimizer-state paths with leaf shapes beside existing cards.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Do not require optimizer state to have exactly the parameter tree: distinguish matched gradient leaves from extra state.

lessons.title: Compiled loops with lax.scan
lessons.existingFigureTitle: The carry approaches a fixed point
lessons.proposal: Show carry flowing horizontally, per-step input entering vertically and outputs stacked on a separate axis.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Carry structure, shapes and dtypes remain fixed; distinguish final carry from the full output sequence.

lessons.title: Branches with lax.cond
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Both branches form one magnitude function
lessons.proposal: Show a scalar predicate selecting one executed branch while both branches participate in tracing.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Annotate scalar cond scope; batching may transform cond to selection, so do not promise unexecuted work under vmap.

lessons.title: Vectors, norms, and projections
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Projection and leftover form a right triangle
lessons.proposal: Keep projection and residual arrows; add a right-angle marker and explicit vector-sum labels.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Use equal geometric axis scale and verify residual dot direction is zero within tolerance.

lessons.title: Linear algebra and loss intuition
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A scalar bias shifts every prediction
lessons.proposal: Trace X(n,d), w(d) and scalar b into predictions(n), residuals(n), squared errors and scalar mean.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Each target pairs with one observation; explicitly prevent an accidental (n,n) loss array.

lessons.title: Least squares, rank, and conditioning
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Least squares balances unavoidable residuals
lessons.proposal: Add a column-space projection and nearly dependent column example beside fitted predictions.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Separate unavoidable residual from parameter sensitivity; quantify the input perturbation and resulting change.

lessons.title: The chain rule, Jacobians, and directions
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A Jacobian maps inputs to output sensitivities
lessons.proposal: Show a Jacobian between input/output spaces, a JVP input direction and a VJP output cotangent.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Check the displayed matrix products independently; label transpose and both vector dimensions.

lessons.title: Gradient checking and numerical accuracy
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Smaller perturbations eventually lose accuracy
lessons.proposal: Keep perturbation-versus-error evidence; add a secant inset explaining finite precision.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Do not invent a smooth U-shaped error curve when the actual quadratic fixture cancels truncation error.

lessons.title: Curvature, Hessians, and learning rates
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Unequal curvature produces unequal progress
lessons.proposal: Overlay iterate trajectories on the actual anisotropic quadratic contours.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Contours and paths use the same Hessian, initialization and rates as the experiment.

lessons.title: Write gradient descent yourself
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Gradient descent trades step size for stability
lessons.proposal: Show signed steps on a one-dimensional loss curve to explain overshoot hidden by loss-only curves.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Mark the gradient and negative update separately; calculate the first two iterates independently.

lessons.title: Probability, likelihood, and stable losses
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Confidence is rewarded only when it matches the label
lessons.proposal: Keep stable binary loss versus logit; label the observed target and the logit-to-probability relationship.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: At logit zero, both binary targets have loss log(2); distinguish analytic curves from measured learning.

lessons.title: Regularization and honest validation
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Training error and validation error select different penalties
lessons.proposal: Show train-only fitting, validation-based selection and one final test evaluation alongside regularization curves.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: No fitting or hyperparameter feedback originates from the test split.

lessons.title: Minibatches, expectation, and gradient noise
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Averaging independent gradients reduces variance
lessons.proposal: Explain independent sampling and averaging; contrast equal-size with unequal-size batch aggregation.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Use summed gradients/losses and counts when sizes differ; state assumptions behind variance scaling.

lessons.title: Optimize with Optax
lessons.existingFigureTitle: The fitted line recovers slope and bias
lessons.proposal: Upgrade update cards into parameters plus optimizer-state feedback, gradients, tx.update and apply_updates.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Show both returned values and the completed-step counter; do not discard optimizer state.

lessons.title: Adam, clipping, and learning-rate schedules
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Compare optimizer paths under a fixed update budget
lessons.proposal: Add Adam moment flow, global-norm versus coordinate clipping, and a schedule indexed by completed updates.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Existing comparison uses different learning rates and does not demonstrate clipping or scheduling; new panels require their own explicit fixtures.

lessons.title: Build a tiny multilayer perceptron
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A tiny MLP separates the XOR regions
lessons.proposal: Add the actual MLP layer widths, activation and batch shapes beside the XOR decision field.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Derive widths from lesson code; the field is a fitted fixture, not evidence of general classification quality.

lessons.title: Model and state with Flax NNX
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Separate graph structure from trainable and other state
lessons.proposal: Retain the existing merge concept; distinguish graph structure, parameters and other state with concrete paths.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Demonstrate alias/clone behavior using the actual NNX operations rather than generic module assumptions.

lessons.title: A compiled train and evaluation step
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Inspect predictions on held-out inputs
lessons.proposal: Compare a train step and evaluation step, showing gradients, optimizer updates and mutable state ownership.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Evaluation uses frozen fitted state and no parameter update; depict only mechanisms present in this lesson.

lessons.title: Train a CNN on a small dataset
lessons.existingFigureTitle: See the image task and its classification errors
lessons.proposal: Show the actual convolution receptive field, stride/padding and pooling-to-classifier shape path.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Calculate one output coordinate by hand and match code layout; retain image examples and confusion matrix.

lessons.title: Debug unstable learning
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Correct gradients can still produce unstable training
lessons.proposal: Connect nonfinite values, gradient norms, scale and step size to distinct debugging checks.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Present checks as hypotheses, not proof that clipping fixes the root cause.

lessons.title: Design an input pipeline
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Shuffling changes order, not dataset membership
lessons.proposal: Replace connected sample-ID lines as the lead explanation with numbered examples, shuffle order and batch boundaries.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: IDs are categorical; preserve membership and show the final partial batch/mask policy.

lessons.title: Load, batch, and checkpoint order with Grain
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Restoring the iterator repeats the next batch
lessons.proposal: Show consumed batch, checkpointed cursor and identical next batch after restore instead of ID-height bars.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Compare ordered IDs and data content before/after restore, not just batch size.

lessons.title: Save model, optimizer, and random state
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A checkpoint must retain the next update’s inputs
lessons.proposal: Keep the existing parallel merge flow; add one consistent snapshot boundary for model, optimizer, key and step.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Inputs join the same snapshot; do not turn parallel state into a sequential dependency chain.

lessons.title: Recover data position and resume
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Data position completes the recovery boundary
lessons.proposal: Upgrade existing cards with model/key/data-position tracks crossing one completed-step boundary.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: The next restored update consumes the same examples and key as uninterrupted execution.

lessons.title: Asynchronous checkpoints and failure boundaries
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A live step can be ahead of the accepted checkpoint
lessons.proposal: Show request, writing, completion, validation and checkpoint acceptance with a crash between stages.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Writing requested is not committed; completion alone must not imply durability beyond the storage contract.

lessons.title: Track experiments and lineage with MLflow
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Compare the runs that MLflow actually recorded
lessons.proposal: Connect dataset, source, configuration, MLflow run, checkpoints, evaluation and selected artifact.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Every plotted run resolves to actual recorded identities; distinguish a tracking run from the deployable model.

lessons.title: Attention from small pieces
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Each query distributes one unit of attention
lessons.proposal: Add Q/K/V shapes, scaled scores, key-axis softmax and weighted value combination beside heatmaps.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Rows normalize over eligible keys; independently reconstruct one output row.

lessons.title: Masking, tokenization, and sequence packing
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A causal mask blocks future information
lessons.proposal: Retain the interactive causal mask; align shifted targets, segment boundaries, padding and loss eligibility.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Attention masks and loss masks have different jobs; packed examples cannot see other segments.

lessons.title: A Transformer block and mixed precision
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A residual block adds a correction to its input
lessons.proposal: Diagram the actual single-head pre-LN block, residual additions, width-8 stream and width-16 GELU branch.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Do not import multihead, RoPE or KV-cache components from other models; explain equal heatmap rows from this fixture.

lessons.title: Train, checkpoint, and generate
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Inspect next-token probabilities before greedy decoding
lessons.proposal: Contrast teacher-forced training with greedy next-token selection and context growth.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Use actual termination/context rules; add a KV cache only in a lesson/project that implements one.

lessons.title: Benchmark asynchronous work correctly
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Separate the first call from warm measurements
lessons.proposal: Show dispatch, returned handle, completion wait, first-call cost and warm execution.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: A timer ending before synchronization cannot establish completed-device latency.

lessons.title: Diagnose recompilation and host synchronization
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A new value is not necessarily a new trace
lessons.proposal: Show calls grouped by relevant shape/dtype/static signature and observed trace count.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Trace count is not automatically compilation count; avoid promising every cache hit across processes.

lessons.title: Read an XProf trace
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Where four annotated steps spent host time
lessons.proposal: Use actual recorded event start/duration to show nested host regions and device activity where available.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Do not sum nested spans or label host annotations as GPU kernel timings.

lessons.title: Reason with HLO and the roofline model
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A hypothetical roofline bends at the compute budget
lessons.proposal: Keep the hypothetical roofline; mark ridge point and one explicitly modeled workload position.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Bandwidth and compute limits remain assumptions until measured on named hardware.

lessons.title: Memory, rematerialization, and optimization tradeoffs
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Changed autodiff storage does not guarantee changed compiled buffers
lessons.proposal: Show saved intermediates, their liveness and recomputation during backward execution.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Autodiff saved entries, estimated bytes and compiled peak buffers are different measurements.

lessons.title: Arrays, meshes, and sharding
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Row sharding and column sharding place the same array differently
lessons.proposal: Reuse categorical ownership maps; connect named mesh axes and PartitionSpec to global and local shapes.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Replicated values and partitioned values are visibly distinct; logical CPU devices stay inside one host.

lessons.title: A sharded training step
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Sharded differentiation matches the global reference
lessons.proposal: Show data shards, local loss sums/counts, replicated parameters and global gradient formation.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Verify uneven-batch weighting against an unsharded reference; do not blindly average local means.

lessons.title: Communication-efficient algorithms
lessons.existingFigureTitle: One mathematical gradient, different local storage
lessons.proposal: Show chunk ownership through reduce-scatter, all-gather and all-reduce with per-rank payload accounting.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Label the assumed algorithm/topology and modeled bytes; do not present them as measured network traffic.

lessons.title: Resilient distributed training
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Restored updates reproduce the reference trajectory
lessons.proposal: Show coordinated checkpoint agreement and restart at a consistent step across logical participants.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Existing CPU continuation proves fixture recovery, not multi-host fault tolerance.

lessons.title: A functional physical simulation
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A correct Euler program still has time-step error
lessons.proposal: Keep Euler versus analytic trajectories; add one tangent-step inset.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Separate local step error and accumulated global error; changing step size changes the numerical trajectory.

lessons.title: Vectorize trajectories and scan time
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Batching preserves independent physical trajectories
lessons.proposal: Show vmap across independent trajectories and scan along time with state shapes.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: No arrows connect independent trajectories; order of axes matches returned arrays.

lessons.title: Differentiate through a solver
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A solver gradient converges toward the physical sensitivity
lessons.proposal: Trace parameter sensitivity through discrete solver steps beside convergence toward analytic sensitivity.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Name the differentiated discretization; avoid implying an exact continuous-time gradient at finite step size.

lessons.title: Fit parameters and scale the simulation
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Recover a physical rate, then check what the fit means
lessons.proposal: Show parameter, simulated observations, observed times and fit objective; add an identifiability counterexample.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Different parameter settings must be compared using the same observation contract and noise assumptions.

lessons.title: Distributions and sampling
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A precise mean does not remove observation noise
lessons.proposal: Place observation spread beside the sampling distribution of the sample mean.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Use matching units and declared sample size; the standard-error curve is analytic, not repeated empirical sampling.

lessons.title: Build a Bayesian regression
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Prediction uncertainty grows away from the observed center
lessons.proposal: Overlay posterior mean with separately labeled latent-function and observation uncertainty bands.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Derive bands from actual posterior covariance and noise; name probability content and avoid vague confidence terminology.

lessons.title: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and sampler diagnostics
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Four HMC traces around a known posterior mean
lessons.proposal: Add leapfrog position/momentum steps plus autocorrelation/ESS diagnostics beside existing chain traces.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Correct-looking traces alone do not certify mixing; compute diagnostics from unthinned retained samples when available.

lessons.title: Variational inference and model checking
lessons.existingFigureTitle: An accurate mean can coexist with underestimated uncertainty
lessons.proposal: Show the correlated reference posterior and diagonal approximation, then a projected sum distribution.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Generate contours from actual covariance matrices; explain how missing covariance changes uncertainty.

lessons.title: Write a functional environment
lessons.existingFigureTitle: One goal reward, then absorbing padding
lessons.proposal: Show environment state, action, goal reward, timeout and absorbing padding.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Distinguish the transition that earns reward from later terminal-state padding.

lessons.title: Batch environments and scan rollouts
lessons.existingFigureTitle: The live batch shrinks while the array shape stays fixed
lessons.proposal: Map time against environment index with alive/done masks and fixed array shapes.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Count the terminal transition correctly; masked padding contributes no invented rewards.

lessons.title: Policy gradients and PPO
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Two sampled training procedures, one exact evaluator
lessons.proposal: Show old/current policy ratio, fixed advantages and positive/negative-advantage PPO clipping cases.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Clipping changes the objective; it does not enforce a hard bound on policy movement.

lessons.title: Evaluate agents across seeds
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Held-out returns for independently trained agents
lessons.proposal: Expose all training-seed results beside aggregate returns, with evaluation-seed grouping.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Distinguish training-seed variability from within-agent evaluation variability; label interval method if added.

lessons.title: Pallas grids and BlockSpecs
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Nine programs cover a matrix with partial boundary tiles
lessons.proposal: Use discrete program-ID colors, tile outlines and separate logical versus padded extents.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Nine program IDs are categories; independently enumerate coverage and verify boundary masks for the 5-by-11 fixture.

lessons.title: A first TPU kernel
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Bias and ReLU alter the values, not the tile ownership contract
lessons.proposal: Trace memory inputs through bias broadcast and ReLU into output tiles.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Use the declared layout and dtype; diagram semantics without claiming verified hardware throughput.

lessons.title: Tiling, memory, and pipelining
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Fewer tile programs can require more work and local storage
lessons.proposal: Show load/compute/store stages and two/three-buffer lifetimes beside tile-count/storage bars.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Label illustrative durations and CPU interpretation; actual overlap requires an accelerator trace.

lessons.title: Iterate with correctness and performance evidence
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Precision gaps remain after kernel correctness passes
lessons.proposal: Split original high-precision inputs and represented low-precision inputs into their respective references.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Separate quantization/representation error from kernel implementation error and from performance qualification.

lessons.title: Read your first jaxpr
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Follow values through the jaxpr operations
lessons.proposal: Translate the actual jaxpr into primitives with input, literal, intermediate and output shapes/dtypes.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Each edge corresponds to a real variable; reductions identify axes explicitly.

lessons.title: JVPs, VJPs, and higher-order derivatives
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Forward and reverse products live in different spaces
lessons.proposal: Place tangent propagation and cotangent pullback on the same primal graph.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Check the adjoint identity between JVP and VJP with independent dot products.

lessons.title: Custom derivative rules
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A stable custom rule preserves both slope and curvature
lessons.proposal: Keep slope/curvature evidence; optionally add primal/residual/custom backward connections.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: The custom derivative obeys the stated rule and remains linear in tangent/cotangent inputs.

lessons.title: Lowering, compilation, and a tiny transformation
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A composed interpreter tracks the analytic directional derivative
lessons.proposal: Show trace to jaxpr, the tiny interpreter/transformation, lowering and compilation as distinct stages.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Identify which stages the exercise implements and which JAX supplies.

lessons.title: Adapt a pretrained model and choose a post-training objective
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Two adaptation objectives evaluated on the same held-out target
lessons.proposal: Branch a base model into supervised adaptation and distillation, labeling targets and objective inputs.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Do not imply this comparison implements a complete RLHF pipeline.

lessons.title: Move models between JAX, Keras, TensorFlow and PyTorch
lessons.existingFigureTitle: A transpose changes storage layout, not the intended model
lessons.proposal: Pair Keras/PyTorch/Flax layer contracts and show weight-layout mappings beside existing transposes.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: A transpose alone does not establish matching architecture, activation, normalization or preprocessing.

lessons.title: Convert PyTorch weights to Flax and locate numerical errors
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Locate the first divergent layer
lessons.proposal: Align reference and converted intermediate activations, highlighting the first divergent layer.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Compare identical inputs and dtypes; record absolute/relative errors and tolerances per layer.

lessons.title: Export a computation and verify its serving contract
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Serialization preserves the declared computation
lessons.proposal: Separate preprocessing, exported computation, runtime loading and postprocessing.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Match the declared input shape/dtype and consumer metadata; serialized computation is not an entire service.

lessons.title: Choose weight, activation and accumulation precision
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Precision choices trade representation for output error
lessons.format: quantization number line and arithmetic flow
lessons.proposal: Show scale/zero-point, clipping, per-channel axes, wide accumulation, bias units and output requantization.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Distinguish weights, activations and accumulation; state supported numeric formats instead of treating all FP8 as one format.

lessons.title: Containerize a model service and verify its boundary
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Observe the process boundary before containerizing it
lessons.proposal: Show build context, image, container process, configuration/artifact mounts and HTTP boundary.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Existing subprocess evidence must not be relabeled as an executed Docker build or container benchmark.

lessons.title: Inference capacity, batching, and autoscaling
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Measured batch computation and a separately simulated queue
lessons.proposal: Show arrival, queue wait, batch formation, service and response as separate intervals.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Keep measured CPU batch computation separate from simulated queue behavior and hypothetical autoscaling.

lessons.title: Deploy at the edge: conversion, budgets and device checks
lessons.existingFigureTitle: An end-to-end boundary includes more than inference
lessons.format: SVG edge execution and memory map
lessons.proposal: Connect preprocessing, transfers, inference, postprocessing and weight/activation/runtime memory budgets.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Only target-device receipts establish mobile/edge latency; desktop CPU measurements stay labeled as such.

lessons.title: Accelerator jobs and runtime lifecycle
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Three actual process lifetimes
lessons.proposal: Show created, starting, ready, running, completed, rejected and timed-out states using actual process events.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: An allocated process is not necessarily ready; transitions need observed triggers.

lessons.title: Health, logs, and workload observability
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Observed progress and committed progress diverge before failure
lessons.proposal: Keep observed and committed progress; mark checkpoint lag and the failure boundary.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Derive lag from actual completed/accepted steps; do not conflate a live log with durable recovery progress.

lessons.title: Failure recovery and operational runbooks
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Resumed loss follows the same continuation
lessons.proposal: Connect symptoms to diagnosis, accepted checkpoint selection, restored inputs and continuation checks.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Branches specify evidence to collect; matching one resumed loss is weaker than matching the next full state.

lessons.title: Changes, rollback, and artifact provenance
lessons.existingFigureTitle: The selected artifact changes only after a passing gate
lessons.proposal: Replace numeric artifact-ID bars as the lead explanation with candidate, validated, active and rolled-back states.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Publishing and activating differ; a rejected candidate leaves the active artifact unchanged.

lessons.title: Capacity, utilization, and operating cost
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Short jobs spend time outside the update loop
lessons.proposal: Show provisioning/startup/update/shutdown intervals and billed resource-time units.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Job busy fraction is not hardware utilization; modeled price assumptions must not masquerade as an invoice.

lessons.title: MLOps: data contracts, CI gates and monitoring
lessons.existingFigureTitle: An average can conceal the failing slice
lessons.proposal: Connect data contracts, slice evaluation, artifact lineage, release and monitoring.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Show failed-slice rejection despite a passing aggregate; drift triggers investigation rather than automatic retraining by definition.

lessons.title: LLMOps: version prompts, evaluate behavior and trace requests
lessons.existingFigureTitle: The unsupported case changes the release decision
lessons.proposal: Connect versioned prompt, retriever, model response, case evaluation and release decision.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Label the current bounded fixture; distinguish a mocked/non-LLM check from executed model behavior.

lessons.title: ModelOps: own, approve, roll back and retire a model
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Only the reviewed release passes
lessons.proposal: Show ownership, review, approval scope, activation, expiration and retirement instead of acceptance-height bars.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Approval binds model/evaluation identities and target; invalid transitions leave active state unchanged.

lessons.title: Masked language modeling: predict hidden tokens
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Masked language modeling: predict hidden tokens — recorded experiment
lessons.format: SVG token corruption and loss mask
lessons.proposal: Separate clean labels from corrupted input, bidirectional context and selected-position loss.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Clean hidden targets enter the loss only; do not draw the full BERT corruption recipe when this fixture only masks.

lessons.title: Masked image modeling: reconstruct missing patches
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Masked image modeling: reconstruct missing patches — recorded experiment
lessons.proposal: Lead with the actual 4-by-4 image, row-major patch IDs, visible patches, target patches, reconstruction and error.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Visible IDs are 0 and 3; hidden IDs are 1 and 2. Show the implemented linear reconstructor, not an invented MAE Transformer.

lessons.title: Contrastive learning: views, positives and negatives
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Contrastive learning: views, positives and negatives — recorded experiment
lessons.format: SVG paired encoders and similarity matrix
lessons.proposal: Map paired views through normalized embeddings to score matrix and two directional losses.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Identify positives/false negatives and temperature; do not invent a faithful 2D geometry for higher-dimensional embeddings.

lessons.title: Supervised fine-tuning with response-only token loss
lessons.existingFigureTitle: Supervised fine-tuning with response-only token loss — recorded experiment
lessons.proposal: Align input at t, target at t+1, response-role loss mask and causal attention eligibility.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: The role mask shifts with targets; unscored prompt positions can still influence gradients through context.

lessons.title: LoRA: adapt, save and merge low-rank updates
lessons.existingFigureTitle: LoRA: adapt, save and merge low-rank updates — recorded experiment
lessons.proposal: Show frozen W(6,4) and trainable A(6,r), B(r,4) branches with alpha/r scaling and merge.
lessons.acceptanceCheck: Match the code's row-vector convention; with zero B initially, A's initial gradient is zero while B can receive a gradient.
